model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of various medical specialties when fine-tuned on the Mistralv0.2-Base model, with each specialty represented by a distinct color-coded bar. The x-axis lists the specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, while the y-axis shows the negative log probability ranging from -22 to -27. Each specialty has multiple bars, indicating different fine-tuning conditions or data subsets, with the legend identifying them as Cardio (light blue), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (dark orange), Obstetrics (brown), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The bars vary in height, reflecting differences in negative log probability across the specialties, with some bars extending lower (indicating higher probability) and others higher (indicating lower probability). The chart highlights the performance variation of the Mistralv0.2-Base model across these medical domains when fine-tuned.
